claims.statement: Selesnya is the white-green guild of Ravnica, associated with collectivism, the natural world, unity, togetherness, and preservation.
The official guide says Selesnya supporters privilege the communal voice over the individual.
The guide emphasizes that Selesnya is not simply pacifist and can field a large, powerful army.
The guide identifies Mat'Selesnya as Selesnya's founder and voice of nature, dwelling in Vitu-Ghazi.
The guide presents Trostani as Mat'Selesnya's speaker through three dryads representing Life, Order, and Harmony.
Convoke is the Guilds of Ravnica signature mechanic associated with Selesnya.
Selesnya placement signals should weight belonging, caretaking, consensus, harmony, and desire to serve a greater good.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
